info.title: Suiem API
info.description: Suiem hackathon API. Not affiliated with Robinhood Markets, Inc. No order endpoints exist in Sprint 2.

get.summary: Issue a CSRF token (double-submit cookie)

post.summary: Passkey registration options (sign up, or add to the signed-in account)
Verify passkey registration; signs up a new account
Passkey login options
Verify passkey login
SIWE nonce for login (chain 4663 or 46630)
Sign in with Ethereum (creates the account on first use)
Revoke the current session

get.summary: Current user, onboarding state and wallets
Consent state per purpose with current policy versions

post.summary: Grant or withdraw consent (stored with policy version + timestamp)
SIWE nonce for linking a wallet to the signed-in account
Link an external wallet with a SIWE signature (custody acknowledged)

get.summary: Linked wallets
Liveness
OpenAPI document generated from Zod schemas
Feature flags and supported chains
Server-side Stock Token jurisdiction check (VERIFIED_FACTS J-01)
Testnet Stock Token instruments (gated by jurisdiction; addresses unverified until Sprint 5)

post.summary: One-time code to connect the browser extension (5 min, single use)
Exchange a pairing code for a device token (called by the extension)

get.summary: Connected browser extensions

delete.summary: Revoke an extension (web settings, or the extension itself)

get.summary: Thresholds, rate limits and dictionary version for the extension

post.summary: User-confirmed research request (entity, source URL, optional selected excerpt)

delete.summary: Delete this user's extension research requests

get.summary: Search the entity registry by name or ticker
Entity by canonical id (e.g. ent:nvidia)
Registry instruments for an entity, with network and labels (no buy action)
The user's default watchlist

post.summary: Add an entity to the default watchlist (idempotent per entity)
Request an AI research brief for an entity (queued; poll /research/requests)

get.summary: The user's recent briefs
The user's research requests with status (completed ones include the summary and top risks)
A brief (owner only), with follow-up questions and the user's feedback

post.summary: Ask a follow-up question, answered only from this brief's sources (cited)
Mark a brief helpful, incorrect or outdated (with an optional note)
Compare 2–3 entities: a deterministic table from EDGAR + Finnhub figures (no AI)
AI drafting help for a thesis from a brief. Returns a draft to edit; never saved

get.summary: Latest quote with timestamp and source (Finnhub free tier)
All of the user's watchlists with items

post.summary: Create a watchlist
Add an entity (idempotent per entity)

patch.summary: Edit an item's note or thesis link

get.summary: The user's theses

post.summary: Create a thesis (private draft, version 1, with price context)

get.summary: A thesis (owner, or per its visibility)

patch.summary: Edit = append a new frozen version (old versions never change)

post.summary: Set visibility (private / followers / public). Nothing is public by default
Add an outcome review (versions stay frozen)
Pre-trade checks, signed quote (testnet) and the exact transaction to sign
Confirm a previewed order (Idempotency-Key required). Simulated orders fill at once
Report the tx hash; the server verifies it against the preview and reconciles from the chain

get.summary: Order status (reconciles submitted orders from the chain)
Order status timeline
Which books can trade for this user, and why not
Portfolio per book (simulated, testnet demo, faucet holdings), never summed
Order and transaction history with explorer links
Value snapshots per book from fills and quotes
Read-only balances of verified testnet faucet Stock Tokens in linked wallets
Transactions as CSV
